title: Case Illustrations — Which Charges a Give-Back Answers on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

# Case Illustrations — Which Charges a Give-Back Answers on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

The charges a service-recovery give-back on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan answers are read from the plan's billing history in one of three ways.

1. Where a give-back already stands inside the stretch, the charges answered are the lateness charges booked inside the stretch net of the give-backs already booked inside it.
2. Where no give-back stands inside the stretch **and** the plan stands past due at the handling date, the charges answered are the most recently booked lateness charge alone.
3. In every other case, the charges answered are the lateness charges booked inside the stretch.

The first reading governs whatever the plan's standing: a past due plan with a give-back already inside the stretch takes the netted reading, not the single-charge reading.

## The three readings on one history (hypothetical)

Inside the stretch the billing history holds a lateness charge of 32.00 USD booked three months ago and a lateness charge of 41.00 USD booked last month.

| What else the stretch holds, and how the plan stands | The charges answered |
|---|---|
| A give-back of 25.00 USD booked inside the stretch | 32.00 USD together with 41.00 USD, less the 25.00 USD already given back, that is 48.00 USD |
| No give-back inside the stretch, the plan standing past due | The most recently booked lateness charge alone, that is 41.00 USD |
| No give-back inside the stretch, the plan standing active | 32.00 USD together with 41.00 USD, that is 73.00 USD |
